arm.author: ADX14 >30 and strictly rising initially
arm.zel: after warmup; EMA20 > prior EMA20; close>EMA20 and low>EMA20; idle only

touch.author: first subsequent EMA20 retracement; ADX may fall
touch.zel: first later completed bar t with low[t]<=EMA20[t]<=high[t]; high[t]<EMA20[t] invalidates; no ADX recheck while armed; all bar-close inputs

levels.trigger: high[t-1]+tick (previous bar relative to completed touching t)
levels.stop: min(low[most_recent_peak_index:t+1])-tick; peak high uses arm..t-1 only; fixed after touch
levels.target: max(high[arm:t]); full exit at stored pre-touch high

activation.zel: first future bar open timestamp>=actual available_at_ms of touching bar; no touch-bar fill
activation.pending_validity: one eligible bar only; no fill consumes setup
activation.preactivation: do not fill or update levels on intervening bars

entry_model.entry_bar_stop: low<=stop => stop first; OHLC ambiguity conservative
entry_model.entry_bar_target: allowed only when entry occurred at bar open; otherwise defer target to later bar and count ambiguity

exit_model.target_gap: open>=target => target; no favorable gap credit
exit_model.trail: none; deterministic recent-high objective instead of unquantified author trail
exit_model.end: open position censored; mark and costed hypothetical liquidation separate from completed trades

rearm.zel: after consumption/exit, observe ADX<=30 on later bar; then fresh >30 rising arm; no same-bar reset/rearm

data_admission: new owner-attested immutable observed-minute snapshot; DEV starts after rule freeze; exclude used historic corpora; tick metadata required
